item.name: Fetch all the headcount in TeamOhana.

request.name: Fetch all the headcount in TeamOhana.

description.content: Get a list of all valid headcount that exists in TeamOhana. Supports optional filtering by plan, status, hiring status, department, and division. Response format is selected via the Accept header (`application/json` default, `text/csv` for a downloadable CSV). Refer to the [Headcount Data API FAQ](/faq/index.html#headcount-data-api) for more details.

query.description: Filter by hiring plan UUID. Get IDs from GET /v1/plans.
Filter by department. Pass the id returned by GET /v1/departments (a division-department UUID that uniquely identifies a department within a division).
Filter by division UUID. Get IDs from GET /v1/divisions. When combined with department-id, returns the union.

response.name: A list of headcounts as either a JSON array or a CSV file.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

item.name: Generate headcount CSV and upload it to pigment

request.name: Generate headcount CSV and upload it to pigment

description.content: Generate the headcount CSV and trigger an async upload to Pigment. Optionally pass time-period in the body (currently only `"this-year"` is supported) to scope the CSV to the org's current fiscal year. Refer to the [Pigment Connector API FAQ](/faq/index.html#pigment-connector-api) for more details.

response.name: A success message describing the result of the upload.
